title: FizzBuzz
summary: Checking the combined case first, and joining with commas.

steps.title: Order of checks
steps.say: 15 is divisible by 3 **and** 5. If you test 3 first, it says Fizz and never reaches FizzBuzz.

steps.title: Commas between
steps.say: Add `", "` **before** every item except the first, so nothing trails at the end.

board.caption: fizzBuzz(5) is "1, 2, Fizz, 4, Buzz"
